description: Models-as-memory — patterns that store knowledge IN model weights / adapters / caches instead of (or alongside) external retrieval. A registry of memory MECHANISMS: what each remembers, how it is written + read, its freshness/forgetting behavior, and its tradeoff vs RAG. The governing rule: a model/adapter memory is a CANDIDATE source (serves_truth=false) — it never asserts verified truth; the verification rail + provenance still gate any truth-bearing output. Composes with lora_adapters / qlora_adapters (the write mechanism) and the context engine (the read path).

memories.name: Adapter-as-memory (LoRA/QLoRA knowledge store)
memories.mechanism: bake a stable corpus into a LoRA/QLoRA; the adapter IS the memory, hot-swapped per tenant/domain
memories.remembers: slow-changing domain knowledge, house conventions, a product's stable facts
memories.write: train/refresh the adapter (offline); versioned, rollback-able (lossless distillation applies)
memories.read: load the adapter at inference; no retrieval hop
memories.freshness: stale between retrains — NOT for volatile facts; pair with RAG for those
memories.vs_rag: lower latency + no index, but no per-fact provenance — so serves_truth=false, governance rail still gates
memories.tradeoff: cheap fast recall of stable knowledge; volatile/regulated facts stay in the governed retrieval layer

memories.name: KV-cache working memory
memories.mechanism: persist + reuse the attention KV-cache across turns/calls as short-term working memory
memories.remembers: the active session's context without re-encoding it each call
memories.write: implicit during generation; prefix-cache reuse for shared system context
memories.vs_rag: fastest recall, but ephemeral + capacity-bounded; not durable knowledge
memories.tradeoff: cuts repeated-context cost (the oversized-context waste the observer flags); not a knowledge store

memories.name: Trainable memory layer (key-value memory)
memories.mechanism: an explicit differentiable key-value memory module the model reads/writes during inference
memories.remembers: facts written at runtime, addressable by learned keys
memories.write: runtime writes to the memory matrix (editable without a full retrain)
memories.read: learned-key lookup blended into the forward pass
memories.freshness: editable in place — supports targeted updates/forgetting
memories.vs_rag: in-model + editable, but opaque provenance; a candidate source, never truth
memories.tradeoff: fast editable recall; pair with provenance for anything truth-bearing

memories.name: In-place knowledge editing (targeted weight edit)
memories.mechanism: edit specific facts in the weights (locate-then-edit) without full fine-tune
memories.remembers: a small set of corrected/updated facts
memories.write: surgical weight edit targeting the responsible layers
memories.read: normal forward pass returns the edited fact
memories.freshness: point-updates; risk of collateral drift — shadow + monitor before promotion
memories.vs_rag: no retrieval hop, but edits can leak/regress; held-out + side-by-side required (lossless distillation)
memories.tradeoff: fix a known wrong fact cheaply; verify no regression before it goes tenant-visible

memories.name: Episodic-replay adapter
memories.mechanism: periodically distill recent verified interactions into a small replay adapter (the determinism factory pattern, model-side)
memories.remembers: patterns from past VERIFIED sessions (never raw unverified output)
memories.write: scheduled distillation from the verified ledger into an adapter version
memories.freshness: refreshed each distillation cycle; old versions retained for rollback
memories.vs_rag: compounding self-improvement, but only from verified inputs — distill from verified, never from raw
memories.tradeoff: the flywheel's model-side memory; gated by the same verified-only promotion boundary
